snippet.title: Ocean Keeper Co-op – First Look | New Coop Games of 2025
snippet.description:
Dive into Ocean Keeper, a thrilling multiplayer co-op roguelike game, where 4 players take on the role of brave diggers. Your mission: defend the mighty Mech, fight against endless waves of sea monsters, and dig deep into mysterious caves for rare resources and hidden treasures. Between battles, upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, and strengthen your team to survive even longer.

Perfect for fans of multiplayer survival games, roguelike co-op adventures, and online games with friends, Ocean Keeper offers an intense blend of action, strategy, and teamwork. Play with your friends, test your skills in fast-paced battles, and experience the thrill of surviving the abyss together. Whether you love team-based dungeon crawlers or cooperative survival shooters, Ocean Keeper delivers an unforgettable adventure in the deep sea.

Thanks to @bbnomoney for the song! https://youtu.be/6Ro7NubzE9A?list=RD6Ro7NubzE9A
